title: Utshaba Olunomlilo
intro: Kwimihla yokuqala yesityhilelo, kwavela umntu ochasene nenyaniso ngenkani. Esikelelwe ngobutyebi nesikhundla, lo mphefumlo wakhetha ikratshi kunolwalathiso, kwaye ibali labo laba sisilumkiso esiqatha kwiindinyana zokugqibela zesurah.
clues: Ndandihlala kwisixeko esinye noMprofeti, kwaye ndandiphakathi kwezalamane zakhe ezisondeleyo, kodwa ikratshi lam landigcina ndikude nenyaniso.
Ndandinobutyebi obuninzi kunye nezakhiwo ezininzi, kwaye ndandicinga ukuba ubutyebi bam buya kuhlala bundikhusela.
Xa esi sigidimi satyhilwa, ndasigculela ekuhleni ndaza ndajika, ndizigqala njengongcono kunamakholwa.
Ubutshaba bam babudume kakhulu kangangokuba i-surah yeQuran yayithetha nam ngqo, indibiza ngegama endandilaziyo ngabanye.
Ndalunyukiswa ukuba ubutyebi bam kunye nemali endiyifumeneyo aziyi kundinceda nganto, kwaye ndiza kuphoswa emlilweni ovuthayo.
Ndibizwa ngokuba nguyise welangatye, kwaye umfazi wam uza kuphatha iinkuni ephethe intambo yesundu entanyeni yakhe.
